tasks.title: M3 Baseline steps 1x/3x/5x/10x, per component (R14)
tasks.note: Done 2026-11-13 after review round 1 (13 findings fixed) and confirmation (3 wording fixes). Fresh scale stack, commit 2da8d59. 1x meets every target; 3x holds every line; 5x first crossing (metric points refused 22 %, health freshness, queue lag); 10x points 17 % stored. Measured: ClickHouse CPU goes mostly to the platform reads (11-12 cores at 5x/10x; discovery 18 M rows/query), VM ~19/24 cores busy at 5x. Hypothesis for M4: ingest also capped by the exporter (4 consumers, ~200 ms async-insert wait). PostgreSQL, Collector, API not near a limit. docs/scale-tests.md "Phase 11 baseline"; scale/components.mjs.

tasks.title: M4 Component ceilings: ingest, ClickHouse queries, workers, PostgreSQL (R19)
tasks.note: Ceilings measured (docs/scale-tests.md, Phase 11 component ceilings). Ingest: 5x held with readers off; 10x crossed on points only, the Collector metrics exporter flat at ~90k points/s with its queue full and ClickHouse at 2.3 cores. Search at 1x: 8/s held (p95 614 ms), 16/s collapsed (unbounded concurrency, 428 queries at once, ingest lost ~40 % of points). Workers: 1x and 2x (100 rules/100 SLOs) held; at 4x (200/200) platform-api segfaulted (exit 139) in the burst of 102 SLO burn alerts after PostgreSQL refused connections (53300 too many clients); core dump taken, not analysed. Reviewed (two rounds, 21 fixes, confirmation clean). The workers ceiling at 4x is unmeasured: the crash is first in milestone 5.

tasks.title: M5 Fixes: ingest path, ClickHouse isolation, queries, PostgreSQL if needed (R11, R12, R12a, R12b)
tasks.note: One change at a time, before and after; final rerun with held-out 4x/6x for the ±25 % check. 1, the crash: the local channel ran a handler per alert transition with no bound (Juice LocalChannelOptions.MaxConcurrency unset), now 8 (Messaging:Local:MaxConcurrency); platform-api restart: unless-stopped; the harness counts restarts as a crash. Core dump read (dotnet-dump, Alpine SDK container): the segfault is in Npgsql's GSS encryption probe (native GSSAPI InitSecContext, two threads at once) on new physical connections in the burst, not in the 53300 path; GSS Encryption Mode now Disable unless the connection string sets it (PlatformDbContext.WithoutGssProbe). Verified at workers 4x (docs/scale-tests.md, Phase 11 fixes): with the bound alone no burst happened (SLOs already in the database); with both and COPY_FROM=5 (150 new SLOs) the burst came (142 burn alerts resolved in one pass, then 24 fired) and every line held, no restart, no 53300. Also a midnight-UTC test bug fixed in SloTests. R11 step 1 (per-query settings, plus a bound): the API's ClickHouse queries at most ClickHouse:Api:MaxConcurrent (8) per replica, waiting QueueTimeout (5 s), each with max_execution_time 20 and max_threads 2; refused, cut (159/202/241) or unreachable is 503 "Busy, try again" / "unavailable" with Retry-After (also closes the milestone 2 gap: 500 while ClickHouse is down). Measured (20261115T0202/0235): 8/s p95 314 ms (was 614); 16/s degrades instead of collapsing: all ingest stored (was 64.8 % of points), ClickHouse memory 3.7 GiB (was 22.8), 14.1 searches/s answered at p50 5.4 s, 3,308 of 28,777 refused with 503 busy. Step 2 (workload scheduling) deferred to the final full-mix rerun.
